relative_advantage.finance: Potential reconciliation/review benefit; no measured full-cost superiority over manual and deterministic baselines.
relative_advantage.studio: Potential faster drafts, equally unmeasured; simpler checks may suffice.
relative_advantage.evidence_needed: Matched task quality and total human review/correction plus operating cost.

compatibility.finance: Binding now: sensitive tables with no approved external-model environment; BI access and report ownership must align.
compatibility.studio: Public-data sandbox and human editorial release provide a better fit.
compatibility.evidence_needed: Authorized data boundary, access owner and workflow integration.

complexity.basis: inference about the proposed system, not a field estimate
complexity.finance: Connector, evaluation and exception maintenance remain even if natural language is easy.
complexity.studio: Limited engineering/evaluation capacity is the leading remaining inhibitor.
complexity.evidence_needed: Support ownership, exception burden and reproducibility.

trialability.basis: case premise and proposed learning path
trialability.finance: Only public/synthetic reversible comparisons before permission; posture changes learning timing, not permitted data.
trialability.studio: Approved public-data sandbox makes bounded comparison easier.
trialability.evidence_needed: A reversible protocol and named reviewer; no trial has been run in a firm.

observability.finance: Comparable finance-peer references and repeated source-linked results needed; demonstrations alone are weak.
observability.studio: Peer/editor-visible reviewed outcomes could communicate value; same need for repeat use and full costs.
observability.evidence_needed: Dated comparable reference use, retained errors and continuing-use evidence.
